1. ACCEPT — findings/request-snapshot-fallback-freshness.md blob 7f304c3e01cce04c05a35b8696ae19df094d2446. VALIDITY: deductive source-level counterexample (not executed): at t0, cold ordinary read for already Working agent loads canonical snapshot S0, caches (t0,S0), and remembers request snapshot containing generation but no verified time. External ledger change at t0+60s without push (explicitly supported fallback case) changes Working turn start or state. At t1=t0+121s, response check expires entry (AgentCache.Get requires now>=checkedAt and age<2m). Baseline checkWorkingGuidance passes no inbox snapshot for ordinary reads, so fetches canonical S1. Candidate checkWorkingGuidance accepts S0 because generation unchanged, and AgentCache.Get writes (t1,S0); thus current guidance can be wrong, and later calls before t1+120s reuse stale S0. E.g. S0 start 29m before t0, S1 new turn start t0+60s: candidate emits HARD STOP at t1, baseline emits none. Even reuse before expiration must not restart freshness on an empty cache; generation and age are independent. Relevant candidate Client.fs RequestSnapshot 30-34, checkWorkingGuidance 339-356, activateReadyOnActivity and post-dispatch ordering; WorkingTurnGuidance.fs 55-77 unchanged. Existing RequestSnapshotGenerationGuardsWorkingGuidanceReuse at test line 1117 covers immediate/push/reconnect but no elapsed clock. SCOPE: original explicit unchanged freshness, observable instructions and uncertainty, negative controls. IMPACT: wrong or missing advisory STOP and stale lifecycle hints on later calls, under long/paused command or aged snapshot plus missed push/external write; not proven unauthorized mutation or CAS failure; actual incidence unknown. PRACTICALITY: small bounded change preserving verified observation age (conservative timestamp at start of authoritative load acceptable), no blanket refetch; reuse only if identity, generation and existing TTL valid; shared cache must retain observation age rather than delivery age. Failed refresh must not seed stale successful evidence. Existing valid cache may serve normally; fresh fallback only when no valid entry/reusable snapshot. ALTERNATIVES: removing all request reuse would regress performance unnecessarily; TTL increase or push-only invalidation violates spec. Scope for corrective Work: ordinary post-dispatch Working guidance and necessary narrow cache API seam; coordinate any cross-lease change with Lead; no new global freshness protocol or migration policy. Acceptance: deterministic injected-time regression demonstrating expired request snapshot (boundary >=120s) with external canonical change/no push causes appropriate fresh read and correct guidance; pre-expiry reuse seeds original timestamp, later call at original expiry refreshes; failed refresh preserves existing retry/error behavior, no stale cache fill; immediate reuse remains no additional fetch; existing generation/reconnect, activation/CAS/fence and durable state tests pass. Do not require real 2m sleep, universal freshness, or refetch for every response. Preserve pre-existing inbox semantics unless needed for shared seam and explicitly test baseline equivalence.
